verdicts.reason: A has an inverted hierarchy: 'GET A GIFT' is tiny, while the subhead 'with your next cup of coffee' is huge and sits right on the busy sweater and mug. 'Only this Christmas' and the URL are unreadably small on the photo, and the dashed rules cut across the image. B is also broken: 'GET A GIFT' floats mid-canvas smaller than the subhead, 'Only this Christmas' sits large on the patterned sweater, the stars collide with the mug, and the URL is tiny on the photo. Still, B's left column (logo, gifts, subhead on clean pink) is readable and grouped.
